text:
Rory (Sales): Hypersoft legal emailed requirements: POC must ensure EU traffic processed in EU, APAC in APAC; KMS keys must remain in-region (prefer HSM/BYOK); provide per-region sub-processor list and a 1-paragraph attestation for their contract review. They want pricing under $1500 for the short trial. Can ops/security confirm feasibility + ETA?

Dev (SE): Feasible for a short POC. Approach: tenant-level pinning + region-scoped KMS (BYOK import or our platform key). Control-plane audit logs can be delivered to a customer bucket in-region. Background jobs (embeddings indexing, async evals) are disabled by default for pinned tenants; if they need an index we'll run regional index workers. Timeline: 24-36h if BYOK material is ready; HSM import adds ~24h for validation.

Client_Hypersoft: Can you provide an API call we can use to pin tenants and a way to prove residency so legal signs off? Also confirm the $1500 cap.

Dev (SE): API (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/hypersoft/pin \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"region":"europe-west1","kms_key":"projects/hypersoft/locations/europe-west1/keys/hs-key-1"}'
```
Query routing: `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/hypersoft/routing -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\"`

Proof of residency: we can provide a signed manifest listing delivered objects (S3 paths), a delivery receipt from the log sink, and a routing audit log showing requests routed to region. That should be enough for contract/legal.

Maya (Security): I'll need the per-region sub-processor inventory (EU, APAC) and confirmation whether control-plane billing metadata (job IDs, timestamps, source IP) will be routed to the customer bucket or kept in our control plane. Also define PII fields we must protect — standard set we use: `ip_address`, `request_headers`, `user_provided_pii`.

Kevin (Infra): Ops notes: we can: 1) create tenant pin, 2) provision/inject BYOK into cloud KMS in-region, 3) create log sink to customer bucket for audit + billing events, 4) disable cross-region backups for that tenant. Sub-processors (summary): cloud-provider compute/networking, managed KMS, metrics/telemetry agent, backup service. Caveat: some managed infra metadata (short job IDs, control-plane routing records) are stored in central control plane for platform operations. For POC we can include those in the sink where possible. Work estimate: 24-36 hours end-to-end if keys + bucket ready.

Client_Hypersoft: Important: legal requires explicit statement that \"no PII-bearing logs or backups will be exported off-region during the POC.\" Will you provide that?

Maya (Security): I can draft that one-paragraph attestation but only after infra confirms the sub-processor list and the log sink covers billing/audit events. Draft attestation (placeholder):
\"For the 30-day POC, Redwood will route traffic for the pinned tenant to the tenants chosen region, keep KMS keys and backups in-region, and will not export PII-bearing logs or backups off-region. Redwood will provide audit artifacts (log sink receipts and routing manifests) sufficient for Hypersofts review.\"

Rory (Sales): Pricing/quote ask: given the $1500 cap, can we propose a compact POC package? Dev/Infra ballpark:
- One-time setup (routing + log sink + config): $700
- BYOK/HSM handling: $150 one-time (HSM import validation +$200 if needed)
- Key mgmt surcharge: $80/month/region (pro-rated)
Total estimated: ~$930 (w/o HSM extra). Leaves room under $1500. Call out that HSM import may add cost/time.

Client_Hypersoft: OK, please include the attestation and the sub-processor list in the quote. We also need a short monitoring snippet so our devs can check routing during tests.

Dev (SE): Monitoring snippet (curl):
`curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/hypersoft/routing/status -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\"`
Returns `effective_region` and `last_routed_at`. We will share sample output for legal.

Kevin (Infra): Action items: 1) post full sub-processor list (EU/APAC) to @maya by EOD, 2) confirm control-plane billing events coverage in the sink, 3) start tenant pin job once BYOK + bucket are provided. I'll DM the detailed list (sensitive).

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: tenant-pin-2460001234. ID: dr-246000-1. Approvals required: infra + security.

Maya (Security): Once I get the infra DM and confirmation about billing events I'll finalize the attestation. If anything cannot be routed to the customer sink we will add an explicit exception in the attestation and surface to Hypersoft legal.

Rory (Sales): I'll assemble the POC quote, include the API and monitoring snippets, and attach the draft attestation. @client_hypersoft please send BYOK material and S3/GCS bucket ARN so infra can proceed. :thumbsup:

Client_Hypersoft: Sending BYOK docs and bucket ARN now. Expecting sub-processor list + final attestation by tomorrow morning for contract sign-off. Thanks everyone.
